title: A Page Access toggle that is off overrides the add/edit/delete boxes inside it
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role has the Reports Page Access toggle off.
  2. A user is assigned that role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Look at the top navigation for Reports.
  3. Try to open the Reports address directly.
custom_expected:
Reports is hidden and opening its address is refused.

The Page Access toggle is checked first — if it is off there is no entry, whatever the boxes inside.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live role editor / roles list)
